originating_goal: Make the already-released independent heartbeat oscillator source and independently authorized orphan recovery actually claimable, triggerable, and consumable by the canonical StegVerse WorkerCoordinator without making worker/task state causal to heartbeat progression or reviving old authority.
claim_expiration_or_release_condition: Release only after source integration is directly validated and the canonical #122/#12 StegVerse runtime executes the bounded worker(1)->carrier(1)->worker(1) progression, producing corrected oscillator carrier evidence plus actual WorkerCoordinator claims/results for the independently authorized 009/recovery tasks.
collision_boundaries: Do not change heartbeat_runtime/independent_oscillator.py or the oscillator algorithm owned by the active #122 source lane.
Do not make WorkerCoordinator, G18, claims, fences, routes or credentials causal to heartbeat progression.
Do not revive or overwrite the superseded SHWP-WORKER-TASK-CAPABLE-RELEASE-HARDENING-001 claim.
Do not mint or directly mutate G18/G20/recovery claims or fencing tokens.
Recovery promotion may only make the existing recovery task HANDOFF_READY after exact admitted authorization validation; WorkerCoordinator remains the only claim/fence allocator.
Do not create a second heartbeat, WorkerCoordinator, scheduler, vault, route or model runtime.
StegVerse remains primary; third-party runtime is fallback-only.
TV/TVC remains sole credential authority; GitHub tokens and NON-TV/TVC secrets/tokens are prohibited from production authority.
progression_semantics: First worker cycle applies registry fragments, promotes the independently admitted recovery record from BLOCKED to HANDOFF_READY without minting authority, and persists task-capable WorkerCoordinator events; it does not advance heartbeat.

Carrier cycle samples the independent oscillator, persists oscillator-only carrier evidence, and carries non-authorizing assignment-trigger packets for unclaimed HANDOFF_READY tasks; it grants no execution authority.
Second worker cycle independently validates task authority, binds fresh fenced claims, consumes guarded G18 lifecycle state, and may activate the separately authorized 009 and orphan-recovery tasks.
machine_observable_release_condition: Corrected carrier state contains oscillator progression_dependency=OSCILLATOR_ONLY and observation-only provenance; heartbeat event log contains assignment-trigger packets; WorkerCoordinator event log contains canonical non-observer task-capable events; recovery base record is promoted and 009/recovery receive independently authorized claims or terminal receipts; G18 cleanup may complete independently and is not an authority prerequisite for recovery.
next_executable_action: Canonical #122/#12 StegVerse runtime owner executes the bounded worker(1)->carrier(1)->worker(1) sequence and this session immediately consumes and verifies the resulting carrier, trigger, worker, claim and receipt evidence.
